svg.title: Six scatterplots with correlations from −0.95 to 0.95
svg.desc: Six scatterplots of 50 simulated observations each. Top row: r = 0.30, 0.70 and 0.95. Bottom row: r = −0.30, −0.70 and −0.95. Dots hug a line more tightly as the size of r grows; the sign sets the direction.
svg.text: What different values of r look like
Positive r: y tends to rise as x rises
Negative r: y tends to fall as x rises
Each panel: 50 simulated observations as z-scores; x and y share one scale in every panel.
